The customer shall maintain current access credentials, appoint an informant and ensure that each user follows the supplier instructions. The customer must not circumvent technical restrictions, introduce malicious code or permit access by an unauthorised third party.

Each party shall protect the other party's non-public information with safeguards no less protective than those applied to its own comparable material. Access is limited to personnel with a need to know and an enforceable duty of confidence.
